steps.title: Centrifuge cells to form pellet
steps.instruction: Pellet bacterial cells by centrifugation at 5000 × g in a tared tube for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Decant medium and weigh pellet
steps.instruction: Decant the spent LB from the tube and determine the mass of the wet cell pellet.

steps.title: Freeze and thaw cell pellet
steps.instruction: Freeze the pellet either overnight at –20 °C or rapidly in liquid nitrogen. When ready to proceed, thaw the cells at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in B-PER
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL of B‑PER reagent per gram of wet cell pellet. Pipette the suspension up and down until it is homogeneous.

steps.title: Add optional lysozyme and DNase
steps.instruction: Optionally add 2 µL of lysozyme and 2 µL of DNase I for each 1 mL of B‑PER reagent added.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension for 15 minutes (00:15:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Separate soluble proteins
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at approximately 15,000 × g for 5 minutes (00:05:00) to separate soluble proteins from insoluble material. Note: if a large proportion of the over‑expressed protein remains in the pellet, it may be present in inclusion bodies.
